title.en: Unit 1203 Ep.3 — Day 7: The Cold Night

beats.en: Day seven of the blackout. Midnight.
The apartment felt like a freezer.
Three blankets, and still shaking.
Finally, Minsu got up.

beats.ko: 지난 화 여러분의 선택은 B, 할머니네 문 두드리기.
beats.en: Last time, you voted B: knock on her door.

tts.ko: 지난 화 여러분의 선택은 비, 할머니네 문 두드리기.
tts.en: Last time, you voted B, knock on her door.

beats.en: "Come in. Shut the door fast."

tts.en: Come in. Shut the door fast.

beats.ko: 할머니는 거실 한 칸만 쓰고 있었어요.
beats.en: She was only using the living room.
A rolled towel at the door gap,
a blanket over the window.

beats.ko: "집 전체를 데울 수는 없어. 방을 줄이는 게 제일 싼 난로야."
beats.en: "You can't heat a whole home. A smaller room is the cheapest heater."

tts.ko: 집 전체를 데울 순 없어. 방을 줄이는 게 제일 싼 난로야.
tts.en: You can't heat a whole home. A smaller room is the cheapest heater.

beats.en: "Heat leaks out through windows and gaps."

tts.en: Heat leaks out through windows and gaps.

beats.ko: 그런데 민수 후드는 땀에 흠뻑 젖어 있었어요.
beats.en: But Minsu's hoodie was soaked with sweat.

beats.ko: "젖은 옷부터 벗어. 젖으면 보온이 뚝 떨어져."
beats.en: "Take the wet clothes off first. Wet fabric stops keeping you warm."

tts.ko: 젖은 옷부터 벗어. 젖으면 보온이 뚝 떨어져.
tts.en: Take the wet clothes off first. Wet fabric stops keeping you warm.

beats.ko: "마른 옷을 느슨하게 여러 겹. 공기가 갇혀야 따뜻해."
beats.en: "Dry layers, worn loose. Trapped air keeps you warm."

tts.ko: 마른 옷을 느슨하게 여러 겹. 공기가 갇혀야 따뜻해.
tts.en: Dry layers, worn loose. Trapped air keeps you warm.

beats.en: Sharing a single blanket,
two bodies make a tiny heater.
At last, Minsu stopped shivering.

beats.ko: 방값은 내일, 물 나르기로 받겠다고 하셨죠.
beats.en: Her rent: tomorrow, he carries her water.
Minsu's day seven survival score:
sixty-five out of a hundred.

beats.ko: 다음 날 아침, 변기 물이 안 내려가요.
beats.en: Next morning, the toilet won't flush.

beats.ko: A, 욕조 물을 양동이로 한 번에 붓는다.
beats.en: A: pour a bucket of tub water in, all at once.
B: make an emergency toilet from a bag.
Next time: Day 8. The toilet crisis.

tts.ko: 다음 화, 여덟째 날. 변기 대작전!
tts.en: Next time, Day eight. The toilet crisis.
